subject: reading
title: The Ice Race
about: Grace and Vince race on the ice rink, but first there is a knot in Grace's skate lace to undo. The story practises the Unit 6 spellings soft c and ce (ice, race, lace, fence, nice, Grace, Vince), se (house), kn (knit, knot, kneels), wh (when, whiz) and n before k (rink, pink, thinks, thanks). It is decodable at CKLA Unit 6, which the class usually reaches in April.
tip: Point at the kn in knot and knit and remind him the k is silent, then let him hunt for every word that ends in ce.

passage.text:
Grace and Vince are at the ice rink.
Grace has on a pink hat that Gran knit.
"Let's race!" says Vince.
"When I yell, we race to the fence."

But Grace has a knot in her lace!
Vince kneels on the ice and picks at the knot.
"Thanks, Vince!" says Grace.

***
Vince yells, and off they go!
They whiz past the bench.
Grace thinks Vince will win.
They get to the fence at the same time!

"We win at the same time," says Grace.
"Nice race!" says Vince.
Then they go to Grace's house for hot milk.

cards.q: Who is at the ice rink?
cards.note: Grace and Vince are at the rink; Gran only knit the hat.

cards.q: What did Gran knit for Grace?
cards.note: Grace has on a pink hat that Gran knit.
A knot in her skate lace is the problem.
Vince says they race to the fence.

cards.q: What happens first, the knot or the race?
cards.note: Vince fixes the knot before the race starts.

cards.q: At the end, what do they drink at Grace's house?
cards.note: They go to Grace's house for hot milk after the race.

cards.q: How does Grace feel when Vince fixes the knot?
cards.note: She says thanks, so she is glad.

cards.q: Why does Vince kneel on the ice?
cards.note: He kneels to pick at the knot in Grace's lace.
An ice rink is a flat sheet of ice made for skating.

cards.q: Which word is in the story?
cards.note: All three start with the silent k of kn; only knot is in the story.
